LanguageData.PS_InvestBodyMulti: Raise {0} from level {1} to {2}?\nThis spends {3} psycast points.
LanguageData.PS_InvestBodyOne: Raise {0} to level {1}?\nThis spends 1 psycast point.
LanguageData.PS_InvestBonus: This skill's bonus: +{0} → +{1}.\nHold Shift while clicking to skip this confirmation.
LanguageData.PS_PilgrimPathTip:
The road this seeker will be called to walk toward their next tier of Enlightenment:

• Trial of the Altar (combat): a single hallowed site, held against waves of the Ancient Psycaster Order.
• Way of the Anima (pacifist): a longer pilgrimage among the anima trees, with no bloodshed.
• Unbound: let fate (the storyteller) choose either road.

Those who cannot bring themselves to violence always walk the Way of the Anima.
LanguageData.PS_MsgNoViolencePilgrim: {0} is incapable of violence, always the anima (pacifist) pilgrimage.
LanguageData.PS_DefaultFocusTip: Personal meditation focus preference. Used when this colonist meditates at a focus building that doesn't have its own attunement set.\n\nPriority: building's attunement → pawn's default → building's native focus → unfocused.
LanguageData.PS_ResetSkillsBody: Unlearn every psycast and refund all points spent learning and leveling them? Unlocked paths are kept. (Free.)
LanguageData.PS_ResetPathBody: Surrender your highest enlightenment tier? Its path - and the abilities bought within it - are removed, and you must re-earn that tier to choose anew.
LanguageData.PS_MsgPsylinkFaded: {0}'s psylink has faded - no longer a psycaster. They must re-awaken through meditation.
LanguageData.PS_MsgTierSurrendered: {0} surrendered their highest tier{1} - re-earn it to choose anew.
LanguageData.PS_FocusTypeDesc: Attune this meditation focus to a psychic focus type.\n\nA non-psycaster who meditates facing this focus is steered toward that type's psycast schools among their awakening cards when Enlightenment strikes. Leave it on “any” to weight by the meditator's traits instead.
LanguageData.PS_StopMeditatingDesc: This colonist is meditating continuously. Click to stop and return to their normal schedule.
LanguageData.PS_AuraDesc: Toggle the cosmetic Apotheosis aura rendered on this pawn. Purely visual - no effect on the Apotheosis bonuses.
LanguageData.PS_ChargesTip: Free-cast charges: {0} / {1}\nFree while >1 remains. The last charge (1→0) pays full cost and starts the cooldown.
LanguageData.PS_SpecPanHint: Drag to pan • scroll to zoom
LanguageData.PS_SpecLockedApo: Locked - you already chose another Apotheosis path
LanguageData.PS_SpecLockedExcl: Locked - you already picked one of this exclusive set
LanguageData.PS_NoUnlockedPaths: No unlocked paths yet. New paths are unlocked through the awakening cards.
LanguageData.PS_BarComaTip: Meditation today: {0}h of a {1}h safe window. Past the window, every further hour of meditation risks a psychic coma (current risk: {2} per hour, streak {3}h). Long unbroken streaks and deferred card rerolls raise the risk. Meditation at a pilgrimage site is always safe.
LanguageData.PS_BarLevelTip: Psycaster experience toward the next level. Meditation trickles experience, casting earns more, and a flow of ancient knowledge grants a large burst.
LanguageData.PS_BarPilgrimTip: Cumulative meditation toward a guaranteed tier-up pilgrimage offer. The storyteller may offer one sooner on its own, and progress is kept if a pilgrimage fails. The climb to Tier III takes half again as long.
LanguageData.PS_BarPilgrimUnderwayTip: A pilgrimage is already offered or underway for this tier. Send the pilgrim to the marked site to meditate.
LanguageData.PS_BarPilgrimStorytellerTip: The guaranteed pilgrimage offer is disabled (the "Pilgrimage guarantee" setting is 0). Pilgrimages arrive only when the storyteller rolls one.
LanguageData.PS_BarTranscendTip: Meditation toward the next Transcendent tier. Each tier costs more than the last.
LanguageData.PS_MsgOneApo: You can pursue only one Apotheosis path (Tranquil Mind, Transcendence or Umbral Sovereign).
LanguageData.PS_MsgOneMeta: You can pick only one of Overflow, Mastery, Discipline or Attunement.
LanguageData.PS_SpecResetBody: Refund all specializations? Every spent point returns to your pool, all picks are cleared, and any Apotheosis path is undone. (Free.)
LanguageData.PS_MsgNoChoices: No valid choices available yet (learn more psycasts first).
LanguageData.PS_TipNoMates: No path-mates that synergize this skill.
LanguageData.PS_TipHoldShift: ⇧ Hold Shift for synergies and details
LanguageData.PS_TipNotLearned: Not learned - unlock in the tree to start leveling
